description: This file defines the SystemCheckController class, which extends AbstractInstallerVueController. It manages the pre-render setup for the system check screen during the installation process of OrangeHRM, including initializing a Vue component and setting the current screen state.

classes.name: SystemCheckController
classes.description: Controller handling pre-render logic for the system check page during installation, initializing UI components and updating installation state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component and sets the current installation screen before rendering the view.
